connector.name: MCP by heyoden.com
connector.registryDescription: Talk to your Oden AI todo and calendar account from Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP client.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.heyoden, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ODEN_API_KEY
env.description: Oden API key (odn_live_*). Generate one in the Oden app at Settings → Developer → New key. Treat it like a password.

env.name: ODEN_API_URL
env.description: Override the Oden API base URL. Defaults to https://api.heyoden.com/v1. Most users do not need to set this.
